verse.verse_1: HAVE YOU NOT seen how your Lord dealt with the people of the elephants?
verse.verse_2: Did He not make their plan go wrong,
verse.verse_3: And sent hordes of chargers flying against them,
verse.verse_4: (While) you were pelting them with stones of porphyritic lava,
verse.verse_5: And turned them into pastured fields of corn?
